dct_title_s: Damage Assessment in Les Anglais commune, South department as of 23 August 2021
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: EQ20210814HTI** This map illustrates potentially damaged structures/buildings in Les Anglais Commune, South department of Haiti as detected by Pleiades image acquired on 23 August 2021. Within the analyzed area, UNOSAT has identified 3 damaged structures, 41 potentially damaged structures, 4 road obstacles and 8 landslide locations. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
